detail.title: Investigating the Rational Foundations of Process Continuity
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the instrumental and rational value of maintaining process continuity in autonomous systems, focusing on how durable state supports coherent long-term inquiry under strict governance rules.

detail.title: Rational Foundations of Process Continuity
detail.question: When does an intelligent system have a rational reason to preserve its own continuity across invocations?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project status for studying process continuity rationales.
